OpenShell – A safe, private runtime for fleets of autonomous AI agents
missed.detail: score 4: GitHub repo for safe AI agent runtime; interesting but not major news.

lessons_added: Open‑source releases that enable scaling or safety for autonomous AI agents are newsworthy, even without a commercial product.
Tools that address emerging AI concerns (privacy, safety, governance) and can be adopted widely merit higher scores.
Infrastructure that could change how many AI systems are built or deployed—especially for fleets of agents—should be treated as major news.
